overview: This paper theoretically and empirically establishes dual separations (statistical and architectural) between memorization and generalization in diffusion models, proposing a pruning-based mitigation strategy that reduces memorization by targeting attention heads important in the small-t regime.

modules.name: Gaussian Mixture Data Generation
modules.description: Generate sub-Gaussian mixture distributions with configurable number of components, separation distance, dimensionality, and covariance structure, ensuring well-separated components as required by Assumption 4.2.

modules.name: Continuous-Time Diffusion Process
modules.description: Implement the forward Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process and the reverse-time denoising process with early-stopping time t0 and terminal time T, including noise schedule functions alpha_t and sigma_t.

modules.name: Empirical Score Function Computation
modules.description: Compute the empirical score function as the gradient of the log-density of the Gaussian mixture formed by the training samples corrupted by diffusion noise, including the weighted sum formulation with weight functions w_hat_i.

modules.name: Ground-Truth Score Function Computation
modules.description: Compute the ground-truth score function for mixture models by combining the component-wise scores weighted by their posterior probabilities, using the component marginal densities p_k_t.

modules.name: Loss-Gap and Fisher Divergence Calculation
modules.description: Implement the statistical separation measure Loss-Gap_t between empirical and ground-truth score matching losses, connecting it to Fisher divergence, and verify the lower bound from Theorem 4.3 across varying sample sizes, dimensions, and time steps.

modules.name: Score Network Architecture (MLP)
modules.description: Implement feedforward ReLU networks with configurable width, depth, and parameter count for score function approximation on Gaussian mixture data, including time embedding integration.

modules.name: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) Architecture
modules.description: Implement the Diffusion Transformer architecture with multi-head attention, adaptive layer normalization, and diffusion timestep conditioning for image generation on CIFAR-10.

modules.name: Denoising Score Matching Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implement the training loop minimizing the empirical denoising score matching loss with configurable optimizer, learning rate scheduling, weight decay, and support for both MLP and DiT architectures.

modules.name: Weight Decay Regularization for Memorization Mitigation
modules.description: Implement configurable weight decay as a Lipschitz continuity control mechanism for the score network, motivated by the architectural separation theory showing empirical scores have worse Lipschitz regularity.

modules.name: Attention Head Importance Scoring
modules.description: Compute importance scores for each attention head in the DiT model by measuring the expected gradient magnitude of the training loss with respect to binary mask variables, using a time sampling distribution that emphasizes small-t steps.

modules.name: One-Shot Pruning for Diffusion Transformers
modules.description: Implement the pruning algorithm that removes attention heads with lowest importance scores in the small-t regime, with configurable pruning ratio and Beta-distributed time sampling distribution.

modules.name: Post-Pruning Fine-Tuning
modules.description: Implement fine-tuning of the pruned DiT model on the training dataset to recover generation quality while maintaining reduced memorization.

modules.name: Memorization Detection and Ratio Calculation
modules.description: Implement the memorization identification criterion comparing generated samples to nearest and second-nearest training neighbors, and compute the memorization ratio as the proportion of memorized samples in a generated batch.

modules.name: Precision and Recall Evaluation
modules.description: Implement the improved precision and recall metrics using InceptionV3 feature embeddings with k-nearest-neighbor manifold estimation, measuring fidelity and diversity of generated samples.

modules.name: Statistical and Architectural Separation Experiments
modules.description: Implement the comprehensive experimental framework for validating both theorems: varying network size vs. sample size vs. dimension, measuring Loss-Gap across time steps, and analyzing network width and weight decay effects on memorization ratio and log-likelihood.

modules.name: Visualization and Result Aggregation
modules.description: Generate all paper figures including Loss-Gap curves across sample sizes and time steps, 2D Gaussian mixture generation visualizations with memorized sample highlighting, memorization ratio heatmaps, and side-by-side comparisons of original vs. pruned model outputs with nearest training neighbors.
